cause_quote: 963826f2d30 replaced `: staticImports` with `: new Set([...staticImports, ...literalCalls])`, where onLiteralCall collects the first literal argument of every CallExpression that starts with ".", so ordinary strings like "." and ".sqlite" flowed into `resolveImport(specifierPath)` (createRequire().resolve).
user_saw: Maintainers building the desktop standalone executable saw packaging fail (Bun panicked in chunk selection, then the codegen stage could not find the workspace-path-exclusions program) before compilation.
summary: Resolved standalone chunk references through the package-inventory CommonJS resolver instead of native createRequire resolution, and dropped the stale `workspace-manifest-` filename exception for the workspace-path-exclusions program.
reasoning: The fix PR says chunk selection sent every relative-looking literal (e.g. `.`, `.sqlite`) through native resolution and exhausted Bun's resolver; that literal set was added to the resolve loop by #188645 (Oct 31), after standalone selected-plugin builds (#173794) and #183377 (Oct 25, 'restore trimmed AOT builds') had them working, while before it only static imports (or the scoped fallback for loader-using files) were resolved. Confidence is medium because the Bun panic mechanism is taken from the PR and I could not confirm packaging succeeded between Oct 25 and Oct 31; the second half (the `workspace-manifest-` prefix from #172384) went stale when the bundler's chunk naming changed, which I could not pin to one commit.
